The year '''10,000 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''', also known as '''26,463 after the [[Tho Yor Arrival]] (TYA)''', '''6,347 before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (BTC)''', '''9,000 before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation''']] and '''9,965 before the [[Great ReSynchronization]]''', was a span of time during the [[Ductavis Era]].

==Events==
*The [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Vall Kumauri]] established his [[Kumauri Empire|empire]] in the outlying regions of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="CRO84" />
*The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] began their recorded history. {{Circa}}<ref name="EGASx" />
*The [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] compiled a list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]], which was featured in his work ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]'', commissioned for the anniversary of the Republic.<ref name="Atlas23" />
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was discovered by [[Scout/Legends|explorers]]<ref name="GatORW119">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> and joined the Republic. {{Circa}}<ref name="Atlas99" />
*The alloy [[madilon]] was discovered. {{Circa}}<ref name="GOI127" />
*The planet [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] is discovered by Republic explorers. {{Circa}}<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
*[[Vima-Da-Boda's lightsaber]] was created.<ref name="Endnotes">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref>
